identity.title: Arizona James and the Lost Relics

win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
When a winning Cluster occurs with a Wild symbol, the Wild symbol will transform into a Pistol Cylinder symbol. The Pistol Cylinder will have between 2-6 available shots. The Pistol Cylinder will activate after all wins and cascades have been settled. When the Pistol Cylinder fires, it will hit as many symbols on the grid as there are shots in the Pistol Cylinder. If there is more than one Pistol Cylinder on the grid, they will activate in order, from top to bottom, left to right. Pistol Cylinders can shoot the same position more than once. Once the Wild symbol has transformed into a Pistol Cylinder, it is no longer Wild.

 The symbols that the Pistol Cylinder hits reveal Special symbols: Coins, Amulets, Sacred Relic, and Reload symbols. After all shots are fired, if a Reload symbol appears on the grid, it will activate and reload all the Pistol Cylinders with between 2-6 shots, revealing new Special symbols. If a Coin symbol gets shot again, that Coin symbol will be upgraded to the next Coin type. If an Emerald Amulet symbol gets shot again, it will be upgraded to a Gold Amulet symbol. Diamond Coins, Gold Amulets, Sacred Relics, and Reload symbols cannot be shot again. Only one Reload symbol can be on the grid at the same time.

 When all shots are fired, and no new Reload symbols are revealed, the Coin symbols will reveal their values. All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - THE CRYSTAL CAVERNS
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the TOMB OF GOLD bonus. In addition, the Bullet Collector is progressive and will start at 5 and trigger on every free spin after all Pistol Cylinders and Reload symbols have activated. After the Bullet Collector activates, it resets to the last collected value it had before activating. The Bullet Collector will continue to collect wins on the next free spin. Silver Coins are the lowest Coin type that will land in this bonus.

 FS symbols cannot land in this bonus.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 FS symbols cannot land at the same time as Pistol Cylinders are on the grid.

specials.name: SUPER CASCADES
specials.behavior: When a winning combination occurs, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination are removed from the grid, and new ones drop down to fill the empty spaces.

modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.retrigger:
extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins 

 If you choose to Gamble, you will be presented with 4 Holy Grails to pick from.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game. This brings you into a Bonus Gamble, where you have a choice to either play the CURSED TEMPLE bonus game or to Gamble. You may Gamble once per bonus and once after a Bonus Upgrade.

 This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics with an increased chance of triggering Pistol Cylinders!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins 

 If you choose to Gamble, you will be presented with 4 Holy Grails to pick from. Pick one, and the selected Holy Grail awards 1 of 4 outcomes:

 One outcome immediately awards a Bonus Upgrade into the TOMB OF GOLD bonus. 
 One outcome awards an immediate Cash Prize of 1x, 2x, 3x or 4x. 
 One outcome awards an immediate Cash Prize of 5x, 10x, 15x or 20x. 
 One outcome awards an immediate Cash Prize of 25x, 50x or 100x. 

 Once an outcome has been awarded, the CURSED TEMPLE Bonus Gamble will end.

modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game. This brings you into a Bonus Gamble, where you have a choice to either play the TOMB OF GOLD bonus game or to Gamble.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the CURSED TEMPLE bonus. In addition, a Bullet Collector is displayed outside the grid. Each regular win will add 1 bullet to the Bullet Collector. On the last free spin, the Bullet Collector will activate after all Pistol Cylinders and Reload symbols have activated. When the Bullet Collector activates, James will shoot all the collected bullets.

 The positions on the grid that are hit will reveal Coin, Amulet, and Sacred Relic symbols. When all bullets have been fired, the Pistol Reveal process continues as normal. FS symbols cannot land when the Bullet Collector activates.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins 

 If you choose to Gamble, you will be presented with 8 Holy Grails to pick from. Pick one, and the selected Holy Grail awards 1 of 8 outcomes:

 One outcome immediately awards a Bonus Upgrade to the THE CRYSTAL CAVERNS Hidden Epic Bonus. 
 Two outcomes award an immediate Cash Prize of 5x, 10x, 15x or 20x. 
 Four outcomes award an immediate Cash Prize of 25x, 50x or 100x. 
 One outcome awards an immediate Cash Prize of 150x, 250x or 500x. 

 Once an outcome has been awarded, the TOMB OF GOLD Bonus Gamble will end.

ABOUT THE GAME

 Legends speak of an ancient kingdom where kings are buried beside cursed relics, sealed in blood and guarded by the dead. Those who sought the tomb vanished into the darkness, never to return. They say these treasures were never meant for mortal hands. But some secrets refuse to stay buried.

 Hunt for hidden treasure in Arizona James and the Lost Relics! In this 6-reel, 5-row game with Cluster wins, every shot counts. Find a max win of {maximumWinMultiplier} times your bet, achievable in all game modes!
